li_projects.title: File Compression Tool (Huffman Coding)
li_projects.description: Developed a Java-based file compression tool implementing Huffman Coding for lossless text compression and decompression. Designed with OOP principles and applied data structures (PriorityQueue, HashMap, Binary Tree) to build efficient Huffman Trees. The project demonstrates strong understanding of algorithms, file handling, and modular software design.

li_projects.title: QR Code Generator (Node.js CLI App)
li_projects.description: Built a Node.js command-line app using Inquirer to take user input. Generated QR codes from URLs with the qr-image npm package. Implemented file handling with fs to save the QR code as a PNG and store the input URL in a .txt file. Demonstrated use of JavaScript, npm modules, and file system operations.
